: bind to AChE → blocks its action which prevents metabolism of Ach → accumulation of Ach at receptor site → buildup of Ach in synaptic cleft
: inhibit the enzyme AChE, blocking the degradation of ACh, increasing its availability and concentration at all cholinergic receptors (muscarinic and nicotinic)
: GI (N/V/D, abdominal pain), anorexia/weight loss, dizziness, bradycardia, syncope, orthostatic hypotension, QT prolongation
Drug interaction: some AChEIs = CYP substrates
Guidelines: Start low, titrate to target
Pt ed: Gen best tol of AChEIs

roles.drugs: Cholinesterase inhibitors (donepezil, rivastigmine, galantamine): somewhat improve cognition in Alzheimer disease and dementia with Lewy bodies; may help other dementias
Memantine (NMDA antagonist): moderate to severe dementia; may be synergistic with a cholinesterase inhibitor
Depression: nonanticholinergic antidepressants, preferably SSRIs. Your table: citalopram for agitation; avoid paroxetine (anticholinergic)
